integration_issues.issue: Multiple 403 errors in console when Support role tries to fetch endpoints intended for HR/Finance (e.g. Failed to load reports/reviews/SLA config). Components still render empty states, so it's non-blocking but noisy in console.

Console 403s 'Failed to load reports' and 'Failed to load settlements/operators' occur for finance role on Financial Reports and Operator Payouts pages. Settlement text renders but data may be empty; verify finance role has appropriate GET access to reports and settlements endpoints.

action_items: Investigate 403 responses hit by Support role loading Ratings (reviews/reports), Live Chat (chat conversations), Templates on load — either grant read access to support role or guard the API calls so they aren't invoked from these tabs.
Investigate 403s on finance Financial Reports and Operator Payouts (settlements/operators/reports endpoints) — ensure finance role has GET permission or fetch through finance-scoped route.
critical_code_review_comments: InAppChat and support components fire multiple failed GETs on mount for roles that lack permission; wrap fetch calls in a role-aware guard or return an empty list instead of 403 for read-only endpoints.
seed_data_creation: Approved 1 pending leave via UI + 1 via backend test (5 pending remaining before UI action, 4 after).
